settings.sg_title_text: From a Single Yard to a {{National Fleet.}}

settings.editor: Founded with just 12 machines in a small Texas lot, RigRent was built on a simple premise: reliable equipment should be the easiest part of any project. Today, that same vision powers 500+ machines across 30 states.
Every machine we deploy is meticulously inspected, every client is treated as a long-term partner, and every job site is operated with the same precision as if it were our own.
These aren't just values on a wall — they're the standards our team lives by on every job.
Every machine passes a 50-point pre-deployment check. We never send equipment that isn't 100% ready.
We treat every client as a long-term partner — not a transaction. Your success is our success.
A growing portion of our fleet is hybrid or electric, meaningfully reducing emissions on your site.
We reinvest in our fleet every year — retiring older models and introducing the latest technology.

settings.sg_title_text: From Our Yard to {{Your Job Site.}}

settings.editor: A streamlined, zero-friction rental experience designed entirely around your schedule.
Browse our extensive 500+ machine fleet to find the exact power you need.
Receive transparent, competitive pricing and availability within 30 minutes.
Our fleet of lowboy haulers securely delivers to your site exactly on time.
Continuous on-site maintenance ensures you experience absolutely zero downtime.
Led by industry veterans with decades of hands-on field experience.
Behind every machine is a team of committed professionals who treat your project like their own — trained, certified, and always on call.

icon_list.text: Rigorous hands-on training for every technician
Nationwide reach with local site expertise
